Get to know the data before modeling anything. Every chart here should end with one sentence saying what it shows.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Run the scripts in R/ first (see the README).
ercot <- read_rds(here::here("data/processed/ercot_hourly.rds"))
```

## Sanity checks

- Do the time stamps line up? Solar output should peak around 1 p.m. Central. If it peaks at 2 p.m. or noon, the hour-ending conversion in `R/02_download_eia.R` is off by one.
- How many hours are missing for each source, and are they clustered (a whole month) or scattered?
- Do the yearly average prices look plausible? Compare a few against ERCOT or Potomac Economics market reports.
